# Boy Scouts: Opossum Theory Test Questions and Answers

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_270_nukaknights-post-pfadfinder-theoriepruefung-opossum-fragen-answers.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

[Update July 2, 2025] Text corrections; "Chemistry" in index

The Opossum test is only shown to you after you have reached the rank of tadpole and have passed at least 3 tests: Pathfinder: Tadpole theory test questions and answers

So at this point you already have the normal **backpack**. In order to get **other mods** such as the **large backpack mod**, the lead-clad mod or others at the vending machines in the Boy Scout camps, you need **Opossum tokens**. You get these by completing **Opossum Challenges** (see World Challenges in the game) or with Change when completing the "**Stories at the Campfire**" event, as well as in the daily tasks "**Crawling Critters Hunt**" (Dolly Sods/Swamp) and "**Radiantly Clean**" (Kiddie Corner Huts/Toxic Valley).

The opossum theory exams are completed at the same terminals in the scout camps as the tadpoles.

![Boy Scouts: Camp Adams & Boy Scout Pioneer Camp (Camp Lewis)](/uploads/nukaknights-pfadfinder-lager-adams-lager-lewis-pfadfinderpionierlager.jpg) 

## Scout Opossum Theory Test Areas:

*With this index you can jump directly to the appropriate areas. Under each area you will find a “back to top” link that will take you back to the index up here.*

## Atomic physics

What are the risks of nuclear or nuclear energy?

**Answer**: All of the above

The T-51b power armor used as a power source?

**Answer:** Fusion Core

Attention! You will get sick if you handle radioactive elements for too long. Which of the following elements is NOT radioactive and safe to handle?

**Answer:** Oxygen

In which country was francium discovered?

**Answer:** France

The subatomic particle that has the same mass as an electron but a positive charge is called what?

**Answer:** Positron

How to pronounce “nuclear” correctly?

**Answer:** Nu-kle-ar

It may surprise you, but just as our cars and toys are powered by nuclear energy, the sun also gets its power from a nuclear reaction! What nuclear reaction makes the sun shine?

**Answer:** Nuclear fusion

What are protons, neutrons and electrons?

**Answer:** Subatomic particles

Elements have families, just like you and me. What is NOT a family of elements in the periodic table?

**Answer:** The Addams

The term critical mass describes:

**Answer:** The minimum amount of material necessary to sustain a nuclear reaction

Your best friend Timmy shows you a discovery he made at the old swimming hole: barrels of nuclear waste! What should you do?

**Answer:** Leave away immediately and tell an adult

Boom! A nuclear explosion! Your friend Mack is asking you for help. What should you do next?

**Answer:** Take cover

The year is 2066. An energy crisis threatens to destabilize the United States. What do our scientists suggest as a possible solution?

**Answer:** The fusion cell

Even though they are tiny, atoms have mass. Where is the greatest mass in an atom?

**Answer:** In its atomic nucleus

Uranium oxide concentrate is also known as…

**Answer:** …Yellowcake

Atoms are marked with a number, the so-called “atomic number.” How or how does an atom get its atomic number?

**Answer:** By its proton number

Atoms are made up of a handful of essential components. What is NOT part of an atom?

**Answer**: Aggressotron
